recipe.title: Salmon pie
recipe.notes: This recipe is from Anne Cunniffe, who made it when Amy was a girl.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 180 deg C and boil a full kettle (for mashed potatoes).

method.s: Melt butter and blend in flour. Gradually add milk and cook over a low heat, stirring constantly until thick and boiling.
Remove from heat, add salt and pepper and a little chopped parsley.
Beat egg into sauce, then add salmon and corn.
Pour into ovenproof dish and top with mashed potato, then grated cheese.
Fan bake at 180 deg C until potato is golden and sauce is bubbling - about 30 mins.
